claims: SpaceX has multiple Falcon 9 launches planned for late March 2026.
Starlink 10-62 and Starlink 10-44 launch from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
Falcon 9 launches Starlink 10-62 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station SLC-40 on March 22, 2026.
The launch window for Starlink 10-62 is 10:43 a.m.-2:43 p.m. ET.
Falcon 9 launches Starlink 10-44 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station SLC-40 on March 26, 2026.
The launch window for Starlink 10-44 is 7:22 a.m.-11:22 a.m. ET.
NASA Crew-9 has an alternative date no earlier than April 1, 2026.
NASA Crew-9 launches from Kennedy Space Center.
Artemis II is no earlier than April 2026.
Artemis II relies on SpaceX technology for key aspects of the lunar program.
Vast-1 is the first crewed flight to the Haven-1 commercial space station.
